capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 2026 IONIQ 9 (same 110.3 kWh pack and charger); Electrek (2026-11-11, src-electrek-hyundai-2027-carryover) lists the 2027 IONIQ 9 as carryover with no battery or charging change; years compared 2026-2027. Hyundai Canada states 110.3 kWh on every 2026 trim.
